title: Seed fill (45, 46) for the K_eff series decision cells: threshold-crossing widths under fixed steps and the larger widths under matched exposure
purpose: Not a new hypothesis test. The K series was screened at three seeds. To report the threshold-crossing widths and the exposure-matched attenuation as confirmatory (five-seed) results, seeds 45 and 46 are added to the cells those statements rest on.
analysis_rule: Re-run tools/analyze_keff_series.py for both budgets and tools/keff_common_subset.py; report d-hat_60 per policy with five seeds where available; any change from the three-seed values is reported explicitly; cells not reinforced remain three-seed and are marked hollow.
